**Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0**, the first final release from this repository.
It's the same code as [2.2.0-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.1),
and installs over 2.1.0, 2.2.0-beta.1 or 2.2.0-rc.1 (HMG-API 1.0.0 or later). The mod's id
is still `wireless-carplay-aa`, so it updates 2.1.0 in place, settings included.

## What's new since 2.1.0

- **CarPlay turns on the cluster and HUD, fixed for more maneuvers.** Ordinary left, right
  and straight turns showed nothing when the phone didn't send an exit angle, or on
  left-hand-traffic routes. At the start of a route the previous route's arrow is cleared.
  (HMG-API#15)
- **Lanes only from the phone.** While the phone guides, the car's own navigation no longer
  sends its unmarked lanes over the phone's real lanes for the next turn. (#4)
- **New setting: "Android Auto turns in the car's own format (AR HUD arrow, distance
  bar)"**, off by default. Near each maneuver Android Auto's turns go to the cluster and HUD
  as the car's own navigation sends them, with the distance bar the AR HUD animates.
  Takes effect when the head unit restarts. (#4)
- **No more loading spinner with Android Auto at roundabouts**, with the icons the car's
  own navigation uses; turns ahead get real icons. (#11)
- **Android Auto roundabouts go the right way round** with that setting on: US and Canadian
  cars always get counterclockwise. Thanks to AwsomeFox (#19, #20).
- **"Recalculating…" on a reroute** with that setting on, instead of a stale arrow, until
  the new route's first turn. Thanks to AwsomeFox (#21).
- **Wireless CarPlay survives a short Wi-Fi stall.** The stock CarPlay library gave up on the
  video after about 200 ms without a frame; it now waits 10 s (applied in memory, the file
  stays stock). Thanks to AwsomeFox (#25, #26).
- **Android Auto's maneuvers in HMG-API's log**, once each, with what went to the cluster
  (#22, #27).
- **Docs:** what makes the AR HUD animate, and the distance bar (#10).

## Known issues

- On some phones wireless CarPlay drops after about a minute (#5). The fix keeps Bluetooth
  up during the session (#2); it's tested by one owner and comes in a later release.
- On-ramps with the car's-own-format setting still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD
  doesn't animate at them (#30).
- Left-hand-traffic roundabouts (#12) and the CarPlay picture recovery after a freeze (#16)
  aren't in 2.2.0.
- The US Ioniq 5 (2023 on) on 260903 isn't in the mod's car list yet, so it says "isn't for
  this head unit"; install anyway works at your own risk.

## Going back

HMG-API doesn't install an older version over a newer one from the app, so: remove the mod
in the HMG-API app and apply, then put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from
[HMG-API 1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) in
`HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install
<zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

An [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose) with
your car, head unit software (e.g. 260507), HMG-API version and this mod's version, what
the phone and navigation app were, and a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
